_doc: Corrections to v1.1 answer_cleaned (the gold answer). The v1 cleaning is line-based: it drops a
line from a leading '(' to the next '.', and, on a line with 'consulte ... pergunta N', everything from the
line start to the pointer, so content before a pointer and parentheticals at a line start were lost.
Each entry: v1_sha256 = SHA-256 of the v1.1 answer_cleaned (lines joined with \n) it applies to; every
'find' must occur exactly 'count' times. After the edits, lines made only of punctuation (left by the
same cleaning) are dropped from every answer, or appended to the previous line when that line has no
